run_sawyer_env_demo: run a demo of a specific Sawyer robot environment by passing its class name via the --env CLI argument
run_pick_and_place_demo: run the SawyerPickAndPlaceEnv demo that samples random actions and renders the pick-and-place task
run_button_press_demo: run the SawyerButtonPressEnv demo that steps the robot toward pressing a button with fixed actions
run_door_open_demo: run the SawyerDoorEnv demo that samples random actions to simulate opening a door
run_close_helper: run the close function to destroy the GLFW render window and clean up an environment viewer
